title: NXH to participate in Wedbush Fireside Chat on September 9, 2026
summary: NASHVILLE, Tenn., September 08, 2026--Neighborhood Intelligence, Inc. (Nasdaq: NXH) ("Neighborhood Intelligence" or the "Company") today announced that Executive Chairman Marcus Lemonis is scheduled to participate in a fireside chat with Wedbush Securities on Wednesday, Sept. 9, 2026, at approximately 10:30 a.m. Eastern Time.

title: Neighborhood Intelligence Terminates Proposed Acquisition of F9 Brands
summary: NASHVILLE, Tenn., September 08, 2026--Neighborhood Intelligence, Inc. (Nasdaq: NXH) ("Neighborhood" or the "Company") today announced that the Company and F9 Brands, Inc. ("F9") have terminated the previously announced acquisition agreement.

title: The Toughest Questions HD Faced On Its Latest Call
summary: Home Depot's earnings beat looked great on paper, but analysts on the call kept circling one large one-time gain to see if the company's core profitability is really holding up.

title: Home Depot's Tariff Refund Never Made It To The Guide
summary: A one-off tariff refund is expected to be consumed by cost inflation the company had not planned for, which is why a quarter that beat on earnings left the full-year outlook untouched.
